speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits, or have you had any recent fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those "drenching" night sweats and significant weight loss are concerning for a systemic illness. Have you experienced any fevers, or have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The description of a painless, fixed, and recently enlarging supraclavicular node combined with your B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) is highly concerning for malignancy. Can you tell me if you have noticed any difficulty swallowing or breathing, or if you have a history of smoking or heavy alcohol use? REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, ESR, and CRP.
